The kits are very easy to find and it’s so much fun to make! It’s such a cool feeling making a common ingredient from scratch. I highly recommend you giving it a go!

1/2 gallon of whole raw milk

1 tsp citric acid

1 tsp cheese salt

Add citric acid to 1/2 cup water, set aside to dissolve. Boil the milk until 185 degrees. Add citric acid and stir momentarily - too much stirring breaks up the curds. Drain in a cheesecloth lined colendar. Add salt and stir. If you’d like you can eat it fresh now, or shape the cheese into a wheel using the cloth. Place a dish and a heavy object on the wheel in the calendar to squeeze out the excess whey. Enjoy!

(These are very basic directions , I’d recommend following kit recipes to a tee)
